title: Invoice retry policy
text: The billing worker retries failed invoice payments three times with exponential backoff. Retry state is stored in the billing_jobs table.

title: Payment retry queue
text: Invoice retry messages are published to the billing queue. The retry worker owns payment retry scheduling and exponential backoff.

title: Customer notification service
text: The notification service emails customers after an invoice payment fails. It does not schedule payment retries.

title: Search index refresh
text: The catalog indexer refreshes product search documents every fifteen minutes using a background job.

title: Database connection settings
text: The API connects to PostgreSQL through the DATABASE_URL environment variable. Production credentials are stored in the secret manager.

title: Invoice retry incident INC-4821
text: Incident INC-4821 was caused by a stuck billing worker. The remediation increased the retry limit from two attempts to three.

title: Refund approval workflow
text: Refund requests above 500 dollars require manager approval. Approved refunds are processed by the payments API.

title: Log retention standard
text: Application logs are retained for thirty days. Security audit events are retained for one year.

title: Invoice retry runbook
text: To inspect stuck payment retries, check billing_jobs and the billing queue, then restart the billing worker. The policy allows three attempts.

title: Product catalog ownership
text: The catalog team owns product descriptions, SKU metadata, and publication status for the storefront.
